events.name: Los Angeles Rams at Seattle Seahawks

headlines.description: Russell Wilson threw a 5-yard touchdown pass to Chris Carson on fourth-and-goal with 2:28 remaining to give Seattle the lead, Greg Zuerlein missed a 44-yard field goal with 11 seconds left and the Seahawks held on for a wild 30-29 victory over the Los...
headlines.shortLinkText: Wilson throws 4 TD passes, Seahawks hold off Rams 30-29

headlines.description: Rookie Kyler Murray ran for a touchdown and led the Cardinals on a drive to Zane Gonzalez's 31-yard field goal on the final play Sunday as the Cardinals got their first win under coach Kliff Kingsbury, 26-23 over the Cincinnati Bengals.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kyler Murray leads Cardinals to 1st win, 26-23 over Bengals

headlines.description: Josh Allen threw for 219 yards and two touchdowns as the Buffalo Bills beat the Tennessee Titans 14-7 Sunday in a defensive showdown for their third straight win in this series.
headlines.shortLinkText: Josh Allen throws 2 TD passes as Bills smother Titans 14-7

headlines.description: Josh Jacobs scored his second touchdown of the game with a leap from the 2-yard line with 1:57 to play, capping a 97-yard drive that helped the Oakland Raiders rally after blowing a 17-point lead to beat the Chicago Bears 24-21 on Sunday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Josh Jacobs rallies Raiders past Bears 24-21

events.name: Tampa Bay Buccaneers at New Orleans Saints

headlines.description: Teddy Bridgewater passed for 314 yards and four touchdowns and the New Orleans beat Tampa Bay 31-24 on Sunday to keep Bridgewater unbeaten in three starts for the Saints this season.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bridgewater's breakout lifts Saints past Bucs 31-24

events.name: Minnesota Vikings at New York Giants

headlines.description: Kirk Cousins threw two touchdowns to Adam Thielen, Dalvin Cook ran for 132 yards and the Minnesota Vikings made life miserable for Daniel Jones and the New York Giants in every way possible in a 28-10 victory Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cousins, Thielen lead Vikings in dominant win over Giants

events.name: New York Jets at Philadelphia Eagles

headlines.description: Nate Gerry returned an interception for a score , Orlando Scandrick took a strip-sack the distance and the Philadelphia Eagles routed the New York Jets 31-6 on Sunday.

After Pittsburgh quarterback Mason Rudolph was knocked unconscious by a head-high hit in the third quarter Sunday, Justin Tucker made a 46-yard field goal in overtime to lift the Baltimore Ravens past the Steelers 26-23 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rudolph exits after scary hit, Ravens edge Steelers in OT

headlines.description: Tom Brady picked apart the lowly Washington Redskins, helped the New England Patriots stay unbeaten and climbed past a former NFL star in the record book.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brady carries unbeaten Patriots past winless Redskins 33-7

headlines.description: Christian McCaffrey tied a career high with 237 yards from scrimmage and scored three touchdowns, Brian Burns returned a fumble 56 yards for a touchdown and had a strip-sack in the fourth quarter, and the Carolina Panthers held on to beat the...
headlines.shortLinkText: McCaffrey scores 3 TDs, Panthers hold off Jaguars 34-27

headlines.description: Deshaun Watson threw for a career-high 426 yards and tied his personal best with five touchdown passes, including three to Will Fuller to lead the Houston Texans to a 53-32 win over the Atlanta Falcons on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Watson throws 5 TDs, 3 to Fuller; Texans top Falcons 53-32

events.name: Denver Broncos at Los Angeles Chargers

headlines.description: Phillip Lindsay ran for 114 yards, Denver's defense forced three turnovers and the Broncos got their first win under Vic Fangio by defeating the Los Angeles Chargers 20-13 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Lindsay helps give Broncos' Fangio first win as coach

events.name: Green Bay Packers at Dallas Cowboys

headlines.description: Aaron Rodgers looked quite comfortable at the home of the Dallas Cowboys -- again.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rodgers, Packers rule at home of Cowboys again in 34-24 win

events.name: Indianapolis Colts at Kansas City Chiefs

headlines.description: The Indianapolis Colts accomplished Sunday night what they failed to do in January.
headlines.shortLinkText: Colts shut down Mahomes, Chiefs offense in 19-13 victory

headlines.description: Matt Breida ran 83 yards for a touchdown on San Francisco's first play from scrimmage, Baker Mayfield was harassed into his worst game as a pro, and the 49ers stayed unbeaten for their best start in nearly 30 years, beating the Cleveland Browns 31-3...
headlines.shortLinkText: 49ers stay perfect, dominate Mayfield, Browns in 31-3 win
